# Trades, move tutors and the Move Reminder

## In-game trades

From `a/1/1/2` (13 trade records, NARC 112) and the nickname/OT bank (0198). "Where" is the map whose script loads the trade or creates a gift/replacement using the trade data. For gifts and replacements, read the requirements instead of the "You give" column. IVs are fixed as listed (HP/Atk/Def/Spe/SpA/SpD).

## Move tutors

Every script that teaches a move with `SetMonMove`. "Who can learn it" is the species list the tutor's own script checks (`GetPartyMonSpecies` followed by a chain of species compares); "any" means the script does no species check. "Payment" is what the same script path takes from you (items, money or coins); blank means free or a condition that is not an item (a badge, a quest, owning a Pokémon). Read the NPC's text for the full condition.
